gloss: to go around telling everyone; to spread (news)

definitions.gloss: to go around telling everyone; to broadcast
definitions.explanation: To go from person to person announcing something, so that everyone hears of it. Today usually critical: the news is a rumor, a boast or something that should have stayed private.

examples.japanese: ⟦{噂|うわさ}→噂：01871_uwasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{触|ふ}れ{回|まわ}る。
examples.english: To go around spreading a rumor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{宝|たから}くじ→宝くじ：18549_takarakuji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たった→当たる：01860_ataru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{触|ふ}れ{回|まわ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He's going around telling everyone he won the lottery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誰|だれ}か→誰か：02912_dareka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{私|わたし}たち→私たち：28351_watashitachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{別|わか}れた→別れる：01113_wakareru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{触|ふ}れ{回|まわ}ったらしく、⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{知|し}っていた→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: Someone seems to have told everyone we had broken up, and the whole office knew.

notes:
From ⟦{触|ふ}れる→触れる：01984_fureru⟧ in its old sense "to make known" + ⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ (to go around).

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive: what is spread takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ (⟦{噂|うわさ}→噂：01871_uwasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{触|ふ}れ{回|まわ}る); a reported claim takes ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ (～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{触|ふ}れ{回|まわ}る).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{言|い}いふらす→言いふらす：34060_iifurasu⟧: to spread around; the closest word, and the commoner one in speech
- ⟦{広|ひろ}める→広める：02405_hiromeru⟧: to spread (knowledge, a custom), neutral or positive
- ⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: to go around saying, plain and everyday
